title: The District 7 Rally
staging:
Scene 07 — The District 7 Rally

05:45–06:50 · 65 sec · Slum rally stage

All five crew members address hundreds of angry cats. Trixie demands transparency about salmon supplies. Byte presents the price evidence. The crowd starts chanting.

Shots: Crane over crowd → low-angle Trixie at microphone → Byte's projected chart → crowd reaction → overhead rally shot.
Explicit public-address sequence: all FIVE cats stand together in front of the District 7 public. Trixie introduces them, then Byte, Ghost, Neon and Onyx each address the shortage. This takes place BEFORE the Steak & Bone dinner surveillance.

lines.text: Everyone, listen up. All five of us are here because this shortage affects every family in District Seven.
